rows.reason: ADR 256 (an internal note, review W1b E3): the decision to close a session-owned game is taken inside that game at a safe tick of its own; the request is re-read and the exiting answer written durably (flushed, read back) before this call, and no call happens when the write fails; her clean-exit record (mod_exit.json) is the process-exit hook's, written only when the process really ends
rows.reachability: OnUpdateTicked: the ready world after TickCommandInbox, and the observer-off branch (config.Enabled false), each only when BridgeExitWhenSafe.Tick returns true (a published exiting answer; Protocol/ExitWhenSafe.cs)
